dogecoin.text: If the common currency in our country is the dollar and your job fully compensates you in something other than dollars or items you can exchange that have a set cash value, you're not getting paid. Imagine if your job wanted to pay you in Dogecoin and Red Robin coupons.

Don't know who needs to hear this, but the people sitting around waiting for Elon Musk to say something on Saturday Night Live about Dogecoin are starting to become eerily similar to the QAnon folks who dissected Trump speeches for clues. Crypto is becoming a cult.
